_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.161 (Serian (Engineers) profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)

species.description: Tech-savvy engineers with superior environmental protection. Serian forces excel at tech tests and are immune to chemical hazards.

traits.name: Tech-savvy
traits.description: Engineers making any kind of test to use, research, modify, repair, or apply technology may roll twice and pick either result. This does not apply to weapon attacks. Additionally, personal equipment used or worn by an Engineer never jams or malfunctions.

traits.name: Enviro-suits
traits.description: Engineer suits are fully insulated against the environment. They are not affected by any hazards such as gas and toxins. Such threats delivered through an intrusive manner (such as a dart gun or animal claws) affect them normally, however.
